verdict.rationale: Asking whether customer data is excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for a hosted SaaS feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of an AI-training opt-out or a no-training commitment. The closest items are data-minimization features: Edge keeps targeting PII local and is never sent upstream, and external metrics stay in your system. Those are adjacent privacy controls, not a training-use policy, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
